evidence.detail: card_search_where() returns tuple (sql_where, message) where message is only populated on error (InvalidSearchException); success path always returns empty string for message

find/ package has no expression-to-human-readable-text renderer; building one would require traversing the parsed Expression/Token AST and producing natural-language output for every key/operator/term combination

triage.notes: This is a meaningful feature: a human-readable search description would require a new AST walker covering all ~20 key types and their operators, plus the boolean connectors — likely 200+ lines of new code and tests.
